description: The teacher clearly states the lesson's objectives/topic at the start.

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher clearly states the lesson objective at the beginning.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Goal was mentioned but vague ("We're learning about animals" vs. "classify animals by characteristics")
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No explicit mentioning of goal statement in first 10 minutes

description: The teacher aligns all activities and practices with the cognitive level of the SLO/topic

completion_status.done: Aligned - Instructions, Activities and Practice tasks match the SLO’s cognitive level (i.e. Bloom's level)
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Aligned - Some Instruction, Activities and Practices are  aligned but some are either below or above the cognitive level.
completion_status.skipped: Not Aligned - The entire lesson remains at a lower or higher cognitive level compared to the intended SLO.

description: Teacher includes at least one 21st century skill in his/her lesson plan.

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher effectively integrates 21st-century skills that are in the LP.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The teacher attempts to include 21st-century skill, but it lacks depth.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ There is no evidence of intentional incorporation of any 21st-century skills.

description: uses picture, chart, demo, video

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher effectively uses the visual aids at the start of the lesson to introduce the topic and engage all students in the hook.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The teacher uses a visual aid but it is not well explained
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not use any visual aid to start the lesson.

description: uses sound, audio, poem or song

completion_status.done: Done ✓  The teacher effectively uses the audio element at the start of the lesson to capture students’ attention and introduce the lesson.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The teacher uses an audio element but it is unclear, or not connected to the lesson objective.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not use any audio element to start the lesson.

description: movement, action, roleplay

completion_status.done: Done ✓  The teacher effectively conducts an activity at the start of the lesson to actively engage students and connect it with the lesson topic.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The activity is attempted but it is not aligned with learning objective or cognitive level, or  students were not engaged.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗  The teacher does not perform the planned activity at the start of the lesson.

description: uses manipulatives or concrete resources other than marker and board.

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher effectively uses manipulatives or tangible materials at the start of the lesson to introduce the concept in the hook.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The teacher uses manipulatives but without clear explanation
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not use any manuplative at the start of lesson.

description: clearly connects to everyday life/situations through specific examples

completion_status.done: Done ✓ At the start of the lesson, teacher connects the topic to real-life experiences and helps students see where it applies.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The teacher mentions or implies real-life application but without clarity.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No attempt is made to connect the topic/SLO to students’ lives or explain its purpose.

description: activates background knowledge

completion_status.done: Done ✓ At the start of the lesson, teacher ctivates prior knowledge of students with relatable questions/discussion and connects it with the lesson objectives
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Teacher recall previous learning but does not relate it to the lesson objective.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No effort to activate prior knowledge.

description: situational / imagine-this setup

completion_status.done: Done ✓ At the start of the lesson, the teacher effectively presents a realistic or imaginative scenario to help students visualize the concept and connect it to the lesson objective.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The teacher mentions a scenario or situation but does not clearly connect it to the lesson or fails to fully engage students in imagining it.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No scenario or “imagine-this” setup is used at the beginning of the lesson.

description: teacher demonstrates skill/procedure/steps

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher clearly models the  skill/steps /procedure step by step, thinking aloud and showing the correct process.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠  The teacher gives a brief or incomplete demonstration without fully explaining the process or reasoning.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not model the skill or concept

description:
teacher explains through any diagram / visual aid (chart, flash card, picture, drawing)/ flow charts, `
``simple writing on the board to teach a concept is not included in this```.

completion_status.done: Done ✓  For explaning the topic, the teacher effectively uses visual aids (diagram, chart, or drawing) to enhance understanding of the concept.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠  A visual is used but lacks clarity, connection to the topic, or explanation.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No visual aids are used during the explanation.

description: teacher uses manipulatives, or concrete resources other than marker and board.

completion_status.done: Done ✓  For explaning the topic, the teacher uses manipulatives to make the explanation concrete and engaging.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠  Manipulatives are used briefly but without clear explanation or the use of their purpose.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not use any hands-on material in the explanation.

description: shows a worked sample

completion_status.done: Done ✓  The teacher shows a complete worked example or step-by-step sample illustrating correct application of the concept.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠  The teacher shows a sample but does not explain each step clearly.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No worked example is shown during the explanation.

description: clearly shows or adress a common mistake or misconception

completion_status.done: Done ✓  The teacher highlights a common error or misconception and contrasts it with the correct method to strengthen understanding.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠  A common error is mentioned but not clearly addressed or corrected.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not discuss any common errors or misconceptions.

description: connects concept to real context through specific examples

completion_status.done: Done ✓  The teacher clearly relates the concept to real-world applications or familiar experiences.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠  The teacher mentions real-world use but without clear connection or relevance to the concept.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No real-world examples or applications are shared.

description: embeds concept in a narrative

completion_status.done: Done ✓  The teacher uses a meaningful story or anecdote to illustrate the concept and maintain student interest.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠  A story is shared but loosely connected to the lesson concept or not fully explained.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not use any story or narrative in the explanation.

description: teacher asks specific oral questions and expects answers.

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher effectively uses verbal questioning to check student understanding during or after explanation and those questions are aligned to the planned lesson objective.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The teacher asks a few oral questions but they are not aligned to the planned learning objective.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not use oral questioning to check for understanding.

description: quick written task on paper or a quick whiteboard assessment if there is any

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher assigns a brief written task, or take a quick whiteboard test to check students’ understanding and provides feedback.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ The task is given but not reviewed or discussed to confirm student understanding.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No quick written or board test given to students to confirm student understanding.

description: CLEAR instructions for students work in pairs with teacher support

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher divided the students into pairs, and provide clear instructions for the task given. e.g., what to do, and how to do etc.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Students work in pairs but with unclear task instructions, or feedback is not given by the teacher.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ Students do not engage in any partner activity.

description: CLEAR instructions for small group collaboration

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher divided the students into small groups, and provide clear instructions for the task given. e.g., what to do, and how to do etc.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Group activity occurs but the teacher provides unclear task instructions or feedback is not given by the teacher.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No small group collaboration occurs.

description: CLEAR instructions for individual practice

completion_status.done: Done ✓ the teacher assign independent task clearly, facilitate the students to complete their work and provide feedback on the answers/task.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Students begin independent work, but the teacher does not check their progress or provide feedback.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No individual independent practice is provided.

description: teacher helps struggling students

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher give focused support to struggling students during practice time.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ Struggling students receive no targeted help during practice.

description: challenge tasks for fast finishers

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher provides extension or challenge tasks to engage advanced students and  fast finishers.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Challenge activities are offered but they are not aligned to the topic.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No additional or challenge tasks are given for fast finishers.

description: final quick written quiz

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher uses a written exit ticket to assess individual understanding before closing the lesson.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Exit ticket used but not reviewed or collected at the end of the class.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No exit ticket is conducted.

description: teacher ask specific oral questions in the conclusion section

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher checks understanding through closing oral questions and student answers.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Not all planned questions are asked by the teacher or teacher does not provide feedback
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No oral check for understanding is conducted before ending the lesson.

description: thumbs-up/down, show fingers/faces

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher checks student's understanding through AFL strategy of thumbs-up/down, OR show fingers/faces, and provides feedback.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Not all planned questions are asked by the teacher or teacher does not provide feedback
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ No signal check for understanding is used.

description: teacher clearly restates key learning points

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher clearly summarizes main ideas, ensuring students recall what was learned.
completion_status.partially_done: Partially Done ⚠ Summary misses main ideas of the lesson.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ The teacher does not summarize the key learning points.

description: students share what they learned or felt confident about, or how they can apply the concept in real world.

completion_status.done: Done ✓ The teacher prompts students to reflect and share what they learned or found meaningful, OR how they can apply the concept in real world.
completion_status.skipped: Skipped ✗ Students are not given time to reflect or share their learning.
